note: Identifies the locally supplied document baseline; does not certify latest vendor revisions, completeness, or implementation correctness.

documents.title: Renesas RA4M1 hardware manual
documents.check_scope: PDF opens; page count and first/last-page text checked. PLN-0013 reconciles all 48 chapters in the complete source-unit inventory; typed driver-facing metadata covers the initial resource/peripheral slice. No separate device errata was available, so the accepted gate is Rev.1.10-scoped and makes no silicon-wide claim.

documents.title: ESP32-P4 technical reference manual
documents.check_scope: PDF opens; page count and first/last-page text checked. PLN-0013 reconciles all 66 published chapters in the complete source-unit inventory. PLN-0015 supplies typed initial resource/peripheral metadata. I3C register content is unavailable and is explicitly excluded by D09 rather than represented by a placeholder.

documents.title: STM32F7/H7 Cortex-M7 processor programming manual
documents.check_scope: PDF opens; page count and first/last-page text checked. Cortex-M7 cache, FPU and MPU properties remain a core-only supplement; PLN-0013 accounts the complete processor-source relationship without using PM0253 for peripheral definitions.

documents.title: STM32H742/743/753/750 reference manual
documents.check_scope: PDF opens; page count and first/last-page text checked. PLN-0013 reconciles RM0433 chapters 2-61 in the complete source-unit inventory; PLN-0014 supplies typed initial resource/peripheral metadata. The correction overlay and per-engine narrative replace defective Table 3 routes.

documents.title: STM32H753xI datasheet
documents.check_scope: PDF opens; page count and first/last-page text checked. PLN-0013 reconciles the complete xI identity/package source unit; typed package membership and initial alternate-function routes remain the driver-facing slice.

documents.title: STM32H742/743/750/753 device errata
documents.check_scope: PDF opens; page count and first/last-page text checked. PLN-0013 completes errata-to-inventory reconciliation after PLN-0014 applied revision-scoped core/cache, AXI SRAM, FPU, DMA/DMAMUX, ADC and timer constraints.

baseline_review.policy: Local PDFs remain immutable inputs. Official catalog pages and remote documents are revision checks and scope sources; a remote document is not treated as locally pinned and therefore has no local checksum.
